desc: Ideation and selection of the primary inclusion-exclusion + CDQ/NTT approach.

Implement endpoint checks and constraint compression: scan S, compute whites before each black, keep constraints (j, a_j) with a_j >= j, remove redundant constraints with equal a_j by keeping the largest j, and ensure p and q are strictly increasing.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to N, and implement an optimized iterative NTT convolution for modulus 998244353 with a naive fallback for small arrays.
Implement the CDQ divide-and-conquer DP for the signed inclusion-exclusion recurrence with the factorial-kernel convolution, including dummy/base handling and the final answer formula.
Integrate everything into a single stdin/stdout Python program and run the provided samples.
Drop unnecessary brute-force validation and alternative-approach tasks after public sample validation passed.
